records.text: Alliance Defending Freedom insiders told Candace Owens that Ben Shapiro was working with Erika Kirk on ways to sue Owens and had become influential inside Alliance Defending Freedom.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep eLgD5yUVbko)

appearances.snippet: Then I get a flurry of emails last week from people at Alliance Defending Freedom, okay, massive organization. ... So they, again, touch some of these people and they're like, you know, Ben is working with Erika on ways to sue you. He's become suddenly very influential in Alliance Defending Freedom.
